headings.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule applies. Use Cabinet Grotesk for a slightly industrial but modern AgTech feel. Tracking tight for larger headers.

body.strategy: Clean sans body for data legibility in dense dashboards.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Neumorphism (Tactile) variants. Flat solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders (border-zinc-800). No pure black. Glassmorphism ONLY for floating modals or sticky headers if applicable.
visual_enhancers.borders: Soft borders (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl). Use Grid Borders for data-heavy inner tables.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) to make the dark mode feel less digital and more earthy/tactile.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-6 and p-8 inside cards. gap-6 for grid layouts.

cards.memory_card: bg-zinc-900/80 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden. Use a subtle top border highlight (border-t-emerald-500).
cards.hindsight_trace: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3. Items connected by vertical lines to show reasoning.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-700 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 text-zinc-300 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors

tags.base: px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-mono font-medium

timeline.node: w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-zinc-700 ring-4 ring-zinc-950
timeline.node_active: w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 ring-4 ring-zinc-950 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]
timeline.line: w-px bg-zinc-800 absolute left-[5px] top-3 bottom-0

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 min-h-screen bg-zinc-950

structure.header: col-span-full flex justify-between items-center pb-4 border-b border-zinc-800
structure.left_rail_memory: col-span-12 md:col-span-3 lg:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-6. Dominant visual hierarchy for Hindsight.
structure.main_command: col-span-12 md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col gap-6. Current incident, Rover evidence, timeline.
structure.right_rail_actions: col-span-12 md:col-span-3 lg:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-6. Demo controls, Action / Validate, Outcomes.

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle -translate-y-[1px] on card hover. Highlight border color change on focus.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for memory cards to simulate 'retrieval' in progress.
motion.state_transitions: Smooth transitions for Day 1/30/60 switches, allowing memory cards to enter/exit.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark surfaces meets WCAG AA. Zinc-400 and Zinc-100 are safe. Emerald-500 is used for accents and text, must check if legible over dark bg (use Emerald-400 for text).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize the Hindsight Memory visualization over standard farm metrics. Show clearly how the system links current incidents to past ones.
Implement Demo Control Panel (Day 1, Day 30, Day 60, Reset) to explicitly drive deterministic state changes.
Build the Agent Reasoning Timeline as a vertical step list (e.g. 'Analyzing image -> Retrieving Hindsight -> Generating Diagnosis -> Awaiting Expert').
Keep typography clean. Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Inter for body.
Ensure 'DEMO MODE' is clearly visible in the header.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for technical, clean iconography.
Avoid generic background gradients. Use dark zinc (#09090b) with subtle borders to separate data panels.
Display warning states for crop anomalies using text-amber-400 or text-emerald-400 depending on diagnosis status.
Use HTML/Tailwind for main structure, integrate Shadcn UI for dropdowns/modals if needed, but standard divs are preferred for complex grids.
Include a 'Save Outcome' button that logically would write back to the memory store.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center on root containers.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot, brain, lightbulb) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for testing.
